prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset type: ONE original landscape map reference for Not 3A Game.
Input roles: Image 1 is the EXACT NEW GEOMETRY GUIDE and overrides every earlier route. Image 2, B — CARTOON 2D, supplies the gray flagstone/grass style from its bottom gameplay strip. Image 3 supplies established red portal and cyan soul-objective identities only.
Owner's latest request: widen the road to SEVEN tower ground footprints, make a DOUBLE RECTANGULAR ZIGZAG, and orient the overall route HORIZONTALLY across the image, portal at LEFT and throne at RIGHT. There is only ONE road, never a branch.
GEOMETRY LOCK: faithfully render the SINGLE gray band in Image 1. It is a continuous open serpentine with NINE straight segments and EIGHT ninety-degree ground-plane corners, making TWO consecutive rectangular zigzags side by side. The overall route stretches LEFT TO RIGHT, with both endpoints at roughly the same screen height; this is NOT the previous vertical single zigzag. Follow the exact guide gray mask through ALL its bends from red disk at left to cyan disk at right. Every gray segment in the guide is part of the same road; do not omit half of it, connect neighboring arms, add gray ground, make a loop, fork, dead end or shortcut. Keep the separate grassy gaps between the arms.
UNIFORM WIDTH: the guide gray stroke is exactly SEVEN ground-footprint units wide, with square/miter corners and equal breadth everywhere. Keep this usable width along ALL nine straight segments and through ALL eight bends. No narrowing at connectors, rounded curves, bulges, broad plazas or variable width. Preserve this projection and exact mask proportions.
SEVEN pale ground squares across the first road reach are a transverse width test. Replace each by ONE small lightly translucent red-roof Rapid tower, exactly SEVEN complete identical towers in a SINGLE row ACROSS that road, on their exact unit-size square bases. Seven roofs and seven distinct complete footings must be countable. No other towers. Do not mistake paving stones for tower footprint units. This is a scale-test overlay, not a suggested permanent blocking defense.
LANDMARKS: replace only the left red disk by the familiar intact dark slate portal ring with red vortex, and only the right cyan disk by the familiar cyan soul sphere in an ice dome on slate bowl. Each landmark footprint is about three tower units across and fits entirely within the seven-unit road. The road ends at those landmarks: no paving spur beyond either end, and no enlarged circular endpoint plaza. Remove all guide disks and white foundation boxes after replacing them.
MATERIAL/STYLE: match B's lower strip: substantial worn rectangular gray flagstones, softly beveled chipped corners, staggered diamond-grid courses, subtle weeds in joints. Warm yellow-green short pointed grass, little flowers, some earthy patches, sparse conifers, pale rocks and broken stone fragments on green ground only. Clean expressive cartoon outlines, readable larger planes, soft painted volume and consistent daylight. Smooth hand-drawn 2D sprite illustration, not pixel art, clay render or photorealism. Small grass tufts may soften the verge but cannot reduce the usable seven-unit gray width or round its squared corners.
FRAMING: wide 16:9 LANDSCAPE composition. Crop excess empty meadow above/below the guide to frame the whole HORIZONTAL double zigzag comfortably. Do not rotate the guide, stack the two zigzags vertically or crop any corner or endpoint. Camera remains the guide's fixed elevated orthographic isometric projection, one flat ground plane.
No text, no labels, no HUD, no inset board, no arrows, no extra route, no bridges/cliffs, no extra mechanics or new tower/enemy identities.
refinement_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
This is a TEXTURE AND SURFACE FINISH edit of the attached geometric game-map guide.
PRESERVE THE GUIDE GEOMETRY EXACTLY. Do not redesign the road. Its gray mask is already the correct horizontal double rectangular zigzag, nine straight runs, eight ground-plane right-angle corners, one unbranched connected route and two endpoints. Preserve the exact shape, proportions, position, size, orthographic projection and widths of EVERY part of this gray region. Do not rotate any segment, change any corner, alter any grassy gap, widen/narrow the road, add/remove a run or attach another road. Preserve the image's diagonally projected edges: do not turn them into screen-horizontal and screen-vertical edges. The overall route already runs left to right; that is locked.
ONLY REPAINT THE SURFACES:
- Gray flat road: replace gray fill with hand-drawn soft cartoon worn rectangular gray flagstones in staggered isometric courses, rounded bevel highlights, small chipped corners, sparse fine weeds in joints. Stone courses follow the guide's isometric axes. A few small rectangular slabs fit inside each unit tower footprint, not one huge boulder per cell. Keep ALL the paving inside the existing gray mask, every corner square and every edge in exactly its existing location.
- Olive green fill: replace with warm yellow-green hand-painted short pointed meadow turf, small scattered daisies and subtle earthen flecks. A few small conifers, pale rocks and bushes may sit far away from the gray mask. All decoration remains on green ground and must not cover the road edges. Clean expressive cartoon contours, soft restrained shading, illustrated 2D sprite aesthetic, not pixel art or a 3D render.
- The seven small pale boxes in one transverse row on the first road run are locked width markers. Keep exactly SEVEN adjacent square ground footprints, identical size, each inside the existing gray mask, stretching from one verge to the other. Keep them as pale translucent foundation outlines with tiny readable numbers 1 2 3 4 5 6 7, NOT full towers; no roofs or big props obscuring their bases. They certify the SEVEN-unit uniform width already present in the guide. Do not add, omit, stretch or move any foundation marker.
- Left red disk: replace with a SMALL intact dark slate arched portal ring and red swirling vortex, its footprint contained inside the red disk's existing roughly three-unit area. Feet on the ground, no extra plaza. Right cyan disk: replace with a SMALL cyan soul sphere under a clear icy dome in a shallow slate bowl, footprint contained inside that existing roughly three-unit disk. Nothing beyond road caps.
Keep every other proportion and relative scale unchanged. Both landmarks should be small compared with the road width and should fit comfortably within seven tower units. No other buildings, no other towers, no skeletons, no route arrows, HUD, inset panel or heading.
Frame the entire existing route in a wide landscape image by trimming only some empty green margin above and below; do not rotate, stretch or crop the road or endpoints. Original project concept art.
